name: Cognopticon
purpose: A spatial observatory for the whole project universe: what exists, what matters, what is stuck, and what an agent should do next.
whyItMatters: It converts diffuse ambition into a navigable, aesthetic, actionable control surface.
currentFriction: It needs to become the place where projects are selected, constrained, and finished instead of another fragment.
nextMove: Use it as the primary morning workbench and add agent run state only after mission briefs prove useful.
decisionRationale: This is the central interface for reducing drift and turning the rest of the workspace into finishable missions.
missionConstraints: Preserve the observatory feeling: spatial first, dashboard second.
Do not expose private paths in any future public demo without an explicit sanitization pass.
Every feature must reduce drift or increase completion pressure.

name: Codex Operator
purpose: A local control plane for Codex work: workspace status, safety policy, sessions, jobs, snapshots, and handoffs.
whyItMatters: It is the operational spine that can keep agentic work from becoming amnesiac or reckless.
currentFriction: The current UI is utilitarian and does not yet provide a rich visual model of the workspace.
nextMove: Expose its registry, sessions, and command safety ideas as future Cognopticon data sources.
decisionRationale: It already contains the strongest operational substrate for safe agent work.
missionConstraints: Do not weaken preservation or safety guarantees.
Treat generated maps and briefs as evidence, not decoration.
Prefer adapters over one-off scripts.

name: Codex Cockpit
purpose: A local browser/API research surface over exported conversations and derived archive artifacts.
whyItMatters: It holds the raw autobiographical and project context that can tell agents what the work has meant over time.
currentFriction: It risks becoming a data-heavy archive rather than a decision surface unless paired with a visual project layer.
nextMove: Use it as a source for future chat-derived project history and motivation timelines.
decisionRationale: It is the most useful bridge from exported conversations into project understanding.
missionConstraints: Avoid mutating canonical archive data casually.
Separate private local intelligence from future public demo data.
Keep retrieval outputs tied to source evidence.

name: Threadgraph
purpose: A graph-native corpus engine for mapping and retrieving conversation structure.
whyItMatters: It can become the deeper semantic substrate beneath Cognopticon’s visible project universe.
currentFriction: Graph intelligence is powerful but can remain invisible without a calm, inspectable interface.
nextMove: Design a narrow adapter that returns project-linked conversations and relationship evidence.
decisionRationale: It can supply the semantic evidence layer beneath the visual map once the UI stabilizes.
missionConstraints: Keep derived views reproducible.
Do not collapse conversation nuance into overconfident labels.
Prefer inspectable graph evidence over opaque scores.

name: Dataset Library
purpose: The canonical local corpus of exported conversations, manifests, and recovered assets.
whyItMatters: It is the factual memory bedrock for personal continuity, project history, and future behavioral analysis.
currentFriction: The corpus is large, sensitive, and has unresolved asset recovery work that requires careful provenance.
nextMove: Keep it read-mostly and surface only project-relevant slices through derived systems.
decisionRationale: It is canonical and valuable, but direct work here should be careful and provenance-led.
missionConstraints: Do not blindly resolve same-name files.
Respect unresolved asset review workflows.
Treat manifests as canonical operating evidence.

name: Excalibur
purpose: A Markdown-first agent harness and continuity layer inspired by Vie McCoy’s original scaffold.
whyItMatters: It represents the bridge between personal taste, ritualized agent process, and practical orchestration.
currentFriction: Harness ideas can sprawl into ceremony unless grounded in real work packets and acceptance criteria.
nextMove: Let Cognopticon generate Excalibur-compatible mission briefs before deeper integration.
decisionRationale: It is the most natural target for turning mission briefs into a reusable agent harness practice.
missionConstraints: Respect the original project lineage.
Keep agent rituals tied to concrete deliverables.
Avoid adding mythology where operational clarity is needed.

name: Memory Server
purpose: A legacy ChatGPT memory/API stack containing the Timeline Vortex prototype.
whyItMatters: It proved that spatializing personal archives feels right, even if the implementation needs a cleaner successor.
currentFriction: The UI is prototype-shaped and the backend stack should be treated as reference unless deliberately promoted.
nextMove: Borrow the experiential lesson, not the code structure.
decisionRationale: It has proven concepts worth preserving, but the implementation should not be revived by default.
missionConstraints: Use as inspiration and evidence.
Do not revive stale architecture by default.
Preserve any useful datasets before changing old services.

name: Operator Studio
purpose: An experimental operator product and personal cognitive laboratory scaffold.
whyItMatters: It captures a product-shaped version of the same desire: systems that make thought and agent work governable.
currentFriction: Core data model and product boundaries are still unresolved.
nextMove: Mine it for interface concepts after Cognopticon has a stable local v1.
decisionRationale: Its concerns overlap with Cognopticon and Codex Operator; pause until roles are clearer.
missionConstraints: Do not split focus between overlapping operator products.
Promote only concrete ideas with working code or clear specs.
Avoid duplicating Cognopticon’s project-map role.

name: Kern Dogs
purpose: GPU/KCA research work with experiments, tests, and mathematical machinery.
whyItMatters: It is one of the strongest signals of technical ambition and nontrivial research taste.
currentFriction: Research code can become high-entropy quickly without sharp experiment boundaries and reproducible claims.
nextMove: Create mission packets that isolate one claim, one benchmark, and one acceptance test at a time.
decisionRationale: It is substantive enough to deserve guarded, claim-sized research missions.
missionConstraints: Snapshot before risky refactors.
Keep tests and benchmarks attached to claims.
Separate research exploration from cleanup passes.

name: Agent OS
whyItMatters: It points toward the broader need for durable agent processes rather than isolated chat windows.
currentFriction: It overlaps conceptually with Excalibur and Codex Operator and needs a clear role.
nextMove: Use Cognopticon to decide whether it is active, merged, paused, or archived.
decisionRationale: It may contain useful harness ideas, but its role is ambiguous beside stronger active systems.
missionConstraints: Clarify ownership before adding features.
Prefer consolidation over parallel harness sprawl.
Keep useful patterns as portable dossiers or briefs.

name: Bounding Square Calculus
purpose: A mathematical research project with package structure, tests, and an explicit calculus framing.
whyItMatters: It belongs to the serious research wing of the workspace: high ambition, high need for clean claims and proofs.
currentFriction: The project needs crisp boundaries between insight, formalization, experiment, and exposition.
nextMove: Create a single mission focused on one theorem, one validation path, or one explanatory artifact.
decisionRationale: The ambition is high enough to merit focused review before deeper implementation.
missionConstraints: Keep claims separate from exploratory notes.
Tie every implementation change to a mathematical statement or test.
Do not broaden scope during proof cleanup.

name: Riemann Real Form
purpose: A structured research/code project around Riemann-related formalization.
whyItMatters: It is a strong signal of the user’s appetite for difficult, symbolic, high-risk intellectual work.
currentFriction: The cost of being wrong is high, so the project needs narrow proofs, reproducible checks, and honest uncertainty.
nextMove: Generate a mission brief that isolates one checkable mathematical or computational claim.
decisionRationale: This should proceed through falsifiable subclaims, not broad undisciplined continuation.
missionConstraints: Use careful language around unproven claims.
Prefer falsifiable subclaims over sweeping assertions.
Record verification commands and failure modes.

name: Fold Entropy
purpose: A research import around fold entropy and related computational/mathematical structures.
whyItMatters: It may contain reusable conceptual material for the broader math/research cluster.
currentFriction: Imported state and unclear recency make it hard to tell whether this should be revived, merged, or archived.
nextMove: Run a triage mission: identify core claims, current runnable state, and whether it should feed another project.
decisionRationale: Imported research material should be classified before it receives more build energy.
missionConstraints: Do not refactor before classifying the project.
Separate salvageable ideas from stale implementation.
End with a keep, merge, pause, or archive recommendation.

name: Parameter Golf
purpose: A cluster of OpenAI parameter-golf competition variants and Parallax Bloom experiments.
whyItMatters: It shows competitive model-building taste and a willingness to iterate through experimental variants.
currentFriction: Multiple variant directories make it easy to lose the canonical best state.
nextMove: Create a consolidation mission that identifies the latest useful variant and preserves why it matters.
decisionRationale: The variant cluster needs consolidation more than new parallel experimentation.
missionConstraints: Do not delete old variants during triage.
Name the current best candidate explicitly.
Separate competition artifacts from reusable technique notes.
